ai.title: Upgrade openai to 4.67.1 and enable store flag
ai.summary: Upgrades `openai` package from `^4.56.0` to `^4.67.1` in `backend/package.json`. Adds `store: true` to the `chat.completions.create` payload in `backend/src/openai-api.ts` to persist generated completions server-side. Changes affect backend API integration and dependency lockfiles.

eli5.text: The backend service now uses a newer version of the assistant technology provider's software, and it has been configured to save each generated response on the provider's servers for later reference. If you looked, you would not see any visible change in how the service behaves today, since the saving is handled internally behind the scenes. This is a behind-the-scenes maintenance update with no direct impact on what you experience.
